cards.title: Practice, honestly
cards.text: 589 laps run and no points on offer. What it does tell you is who looks comfortable and who is fighting the car.

cards.title: Leclerc: 1:35.291
cards.text: In a Ferrari. Take practice times with salt: fuel loads are secret and nobody shows their hand.

cards.title: Colapinto racked up 31 laps
cards.text: Track time is the currency of a practice Friday. Whoever runs most learns most, and burns the most rubber doing it.

cards.title: What they ran, and on what
cards.text: Compound choice in practice is a rehearsal for the race plan.

cards.title: Alonso topped the trap at 346 km/h
cards.text: Early wing choices show up here before anybody admits to them.

cards.title: A clean session
cards.text: No yellow or red flags logged while the session ran.

cards.title: Track between 40°C and 42°C
cards.text: Practice conditions rarely match the race, which is one more reason these times mislead.
